description: Tracks, alerts on, and optimizes cloud infrastructure costs across the production stack — Anthropic API token spend, Supabase compute and egress, Vercel function invocations, and n8n executions. Establishes per-service budget thresholds, monthly review workflow, and quick-win optimization patterns. Activates when reviewing cloud costs, setting budget alerts, an unexpected bill arrived, trying to reduce API spend, figuring out what's costing money, optimizing token usage, or setting up cost governance for a production system. Also triggers on: cost spike, cloud bill, Anthropic costs, API spend, reduce token usage, cost optimization, budget alert, Supabase bill, Vercel usage, what am I spending, cloud costs, LLM costs.
